description: The next free time from the weekly posting schedule the user already set, skipping slots already taken. Prefer this over choosing a time yourself. Returns slot: null when the channel has no schedule — then ask the user, or send an explicit scheduled_at.

after.description: ISO-8601. Search from later than now.

count.description: How many slots to return. Default 1.
